title: $\gamma$-Scape: An Agent-Centric World for Mobile Embodied Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.27306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent embodied agents construct and adapt robot behavior through executable programs, tool use, and interaction feedback. Studying these systems in mobile manipulation calls for physical worlds that connect agent-directed execution with its physical consequences and reusable interaction experience. We introduce $\gamma$-Scape, an agent-centric simulation and benchmark platform for mobile embodied intelligence. Agents compose motion tools and learned skills to carry out complete tasks that combine navigation and manipulation in a persistent physical world. BenchForge grounds structured objectives in physical task instances with instructions, reference programs, and goal evaluators, defining task goals while preserving agents' choice of valid solutions. An agentic collection harness further enables agents to produce demonstrations by carrying out contact-rich interactions through sustained control and physical feedback. Assisted reference

translated_title: $\gamma$-Scape：一个面向移动具身智能的以智能体为中心的世界
translated_abstract: 近年来的具身智能体通过可执行程序、工具使用和交互反馈来构建和调整机器人行为。在移动操作领域研究这些系统，需要物理世界能够将智能体主导的执行过程与其物理后果以及可复用的交互经验联系起来。我们提出了 $\gamma$-Scape，一个面向移动具身智能的以智能体为中心的仿真与基准测试平台。智能体可以组合运动工具和已学习的技能，在一个持久存在的物理世界中执行结合导航与操作的完整任务。BenchForge 将结构化目标落地到具体的物理任务实例中，提供指令、参考程序和目标评估器，在定义任务目标的同时保留智能体选择有效解决方案的自由度。一个智能体式的数据采集框架进一步使智能体能够通过持续控制和物理反馈执行丰富的接触式交互，从而产生示范数据。辅助参考……
tldr: 该论文提出了 $\gamma$-Scape，一个以智能体为中心的移动具身智能仿真与基准平台，使智能体能在持久物理世界中组合运动工具与习得技能完成导航与操作结合的完整任务，并通过智能体式采集框架自主生成接触丰富的交互示范数据。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces $\gamma$-Scape, an agent-centric simulation and benchmark platform for mobile embodied intelligence, enabling agents to compose motion tools and learned skills to complete combined navigation-manipulation tasks in a persistent physical world, while an agentic collection harness allows agents to autonomously generate contact-rich demonstrations.
